root_cause.text: The TLS subsystem failed to purge the `ctx->async_hold` queue inside `tls_decrypt_async_wait()`, resulting in a memory leak of cloned skbs when asynchronous decryption was synchronized via paths other than `tls_sw_recvmsg()` (such as when `tls_strp_msg_hold()` fails).
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows `__skb_queue_purge(&ctx->async_hold)` being moved from `tls_sw_recvmsg()` into `tls_decrypt_async_wait()`. The commit message explains that this fixes a leak when `tls_strp_msg_hold()` fails part-way through, because `tls_decrypt_sg()` calls `tls_decrypt_async_wait()` to process pending decrypts but `tls_sw_recvmsg()` only flushes the `async_hold` queue when a record has been processed in fully-async mode.

intent_record.intent_summary: Purge the async_hold queue during async wait cleanup to prevent socket buffer memory leaks.
intent_record.what: Added a call to __skb_queue_purge on the async_hold queue in tls_decrypt_async_wait.
intent_record.how: It releases and clears any pending socket buffers in the async_hold queue, preventing memory leaks when the asynchronous decryption wait completes.

intent_record.intent_summary: Avoid prematurely purging the async_hold queue in tls_sw_recvmsg to prevent data loss during asynchronous decryption.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to __skb_queue_purge on the async_hold queue after waiting for asynchronous decryption.
intent_record.how: Prevents the premature clearing of queued socket buffers in the async_hold queue, ensuring that pending decrypted records are not inappropriately discarded during receive operations.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the helper function `tls_decrypt_async_wait()` (lines 233-246) but does not include the purging of the `ctx->async_hold` queue inside it. The purge operation `__skb_queue_purge(&ctx->async_hold)` remains in `tls_sw_recvmsg()` (line 2123). Any other code paths that call `tls_decrypt_async_wait()` to synchronize asynchronous decryption will fail to purge the queue, leading to a memory leak of cloned skbs.
